facts.text: The hotel is set within Xi'an's central business district.
facts.excerpt: Honoring both sides of the city is The Ritz-Carlton, Xi’an, set within the central business district.

facts.text: The spa occupies an entire floor and has a zen garden, relaxation lounges, a sauna, a whirlpool and an indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Spread across an entire floor, the hotel’s spa offers an array of treatments designed to complement one another and rejuvenate the body from head to toe.

facts.text: Couples can retreat to a spa suite with a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Couple’s can retreat to a suite with a private balcony, while all spa guests enjoy access to the zen garden, relaxation lounges, sauna, whirlpool and indoor pool.

facts.text: Flair is a rooftop bar and restaurant reached by a private elevator, with a 180-degree city view.
facts.excerpt: A private elevator ride is all that stands between you and the 180-degree city view at Flair.

facts.text: Flair serves cocktails, Southeast Asian-inspired tapas and a sushi counter.
facts.excerpt: The rooftop bar and restaurant offers reinvented and classic cocktails, Southeast Asian-inspired tapas and a sushi counter within a sophisticated, stylish setting.

facts.text: Jing Xuan serves Cantonese cuisine and includes eight private dining rooms.
facts.excerpt: At Jing Xuan, fine dining fuses with Cantonese cuisine to offer a stylish venue for locally influenced dishes. The contemporary space includes eight private dining rooms.

facts.text: Tasuro is a teppanyaki restaurant where guests can watch the chefs' knife skills.
facts.excerpt: admire the knife skills of chefs at Tasuro teppanyaki restaurant.

facts.text: The Lobby Lounge serves the hotel's signature Afternoon Tea.
facts.excerpt: Here, guests are invited to enjoy light meals, gourmet pastries, indulgent cakes, and the hotel’s signature Afternoon Tea experience.

facts.text: Xian Kitchen is an all-day restaurant with local and international cuisines, buffets and an a la carte menu.
facts.excerpt: this inviting restaurant presents local and international cuisines through tempting buffets and an à la carte menu.

facts.text: The Ritz Kids Safari begins with a night camping in tents in the guest room.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz Kids Safari starts with a night camping in tents in the comfort of your room.

facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Center houses a full range of state-of-the-art Technogym equipment and multi-function rooms

facts.text: The hotel offers a Club Lounge with exclusive services and a terrace.
facts.excerpt: Club Lounge with exclusive services and a terrace

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Self parking is complimentary for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking for in-house guests; CNY6 per hour for outside guests.

facts.text: Breakfast at Xian Kitchen is available for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Xian Kitchen for a fee.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
facts.excerpt: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

facts.text: The fitness center is for guests aged 16 and above.
facts.excerpt: the fitness center is for guests aged 16 and above
